title: SpongeBob Fog Horn
blurb: Every episode opens with a blast of nautical brass, and for one entire generation that horn means the television has been successfully commandeered. As a meme it does triple duty — alarm clock, air-raid siren of pure nostalgia, and a way of announcing your arrival with wholly unnecessary force. Loud, unsubtle, unbothered about either. Play it at full volume to start the day the way Mr Krabs starts his, by smelling money somewhere in the middle distance and acting on it immediately.
origin: The nautical fog horn from SpongeBob SquarePants' iconic openings.
